name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Oklahoma City OK

fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is enclosed by a black metal perimeter fence along the S Council Rd frontage and around the truck/dock yard (clearly visible in 2025-05 Street View). Trucks pass through a controlled fence opening off the main entrance drive; classified as a truck gate. No barrier arm is visible across the public-road throat itself, but the secured fence line with vehicle gates is the access control.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance in 2025-05 Street View or 2026 satellite. The main entry is an open paved approach with the Sam's Club monument sign; access control is the fence/sliding gate at the yard, implying kiosk/app/badge check-in rather than a manned shack. Low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because there is a gated/fenced truck yard but no visible guard shack.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court between the building dock faces and the drop yard provides interior holding room; inferred.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Main entrance drive is wide (2 effective inbound lanes at the throat); exit shares the same drive. Estimated from imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Shared single outbound lane at the same entrance; estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and generous paved entrance with room to stripe an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two large cross-dock buildings, each with a long continuous bank of dock doors (east face of north building plus west/east faces of south building). Total well above 50; counted ~80-100 across the complex.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard east of the buildings with multiple long rows of parked trailers; capacity 100+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on opposing faces of the complex (east-facing dock on north building, west-facing Werner dock on south building) but cannot confirm a formal ship/receive split; left false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor on the far SW side of Oklahoma City (S Council Rd) surrounded by open fields and scattered industrial buildings; judged Rural per the small-town/edge-of-town tiebreak.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large white-roof DC buildings on the same Sam's Club property separated by employee parking; a campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two primary DC buildings (north and south) plus minor ancillary structures and a tank farm in the SE.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Estimate from 2026 satellite: ~110 trailers across dock apron and drop-yard rows.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: Walmart cut ribbon on Oklahoma's first Sam's Club DC, 300k sqft at 2400 S Council Rd, OKC; operations began Feb 14 2024.
State of Oklahoma announces Sam's Club new DC in OKC Logistics Park.

verification.rationale: Self-operated Sam's Club multi-DC at 2400 S Council Rd, OKC; live since Feb 14 2024 (LIVE, not just announced). Re-pin to ~35.43,-97.66.
